title: 2023 Panini Select #96 Will Levis Tennessee Titans Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Select sports trading card featuring Will Levis, a rookie player for the Tennessee Titans in the NFL. The card is a rookie card (RC) and is part of the 2023 Panini Select set. It is card number 96 in the set. The card is not autographed and was manufactured by Panini in 2023.
